style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;rounded=0;fillColor=#f5f5f5;fontColor=#333333;strokeColor=#666666;" value="<h1 style="margin-top: 0px;">Semi-trusted Cluster</h1><p>* Runs in a semi-trusted account</p><p>* Cilium CNI used to enforce NetworkPolicy</p><p>* VPC firewall rules may allow restricted Internet egress</p><p>* Workload Identity, least privileges etc.</p>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="170" width="280" x="-30" y="787" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="HzRmuRsm71WE9vN8c5Wq-29" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;rounded=0;fillColor=#f5f5f5;fontColor=#333333;strokeColor=#666666;" value="<h1 style="margin-top: 0px;">Hostile Cluster</h1><p>* Workloads are considered "actively hostile" and account is "assumed compromised".</p><p>* Runs in a dedicated cloud account for hostile workloads - full account-level segmentation from trusted workloads.</p><p>* VPC firewall rules on Node Pools enforce internet egress policies outside of the cluster.</p><p>* Cluster and account are fully audited to avoid any known cloud account privilege escalation paths from the cluster - so we can still rely on VPC level segmentation rules and account-level security and detection.</p><p>* We can't mitigate Cloud 0-days so we focus on limiting blast radius and detection.</p>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="312" width="290" x="686" y="132" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="HzRmuRsm71WE9vN8c5Wq-47" edge="1" parent="1" source="HzRmuRsm71WE9vN8c5Wq-30" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="HzRmuRsm71WE9vN8c5Wq-30" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;" value="<b>Relay</b>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" x="0.638" y="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint y="304" as="offset" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="HzRmuRsm71WE9vN8c5Wq-51" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;rounded=0;fillColor=#f5f5f5;fontColor=#333333;strokeColor=#666666;" value="<h1 style="margin-top: 0px;">Untrusted Nodes</h1><p>* Assumed compromised</p><p>* Zero internet egress - enforced at Node Pool VPC Firewall level (and in-cluster NetworkPolicy)</p><p>* Cilium CNI - L4 NetworkPolicy everywhere (default deny NetworkPolicy)</p><p>* gVisor or Kata containers</p>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="200" width="250" x="890" y="787" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="HzRmuRsm71WE9vN8c5Wq-52" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;rounded=0;fillColor=#f5f5f5;fontColor=#333333;strokeColor=#666666;" value="<h1 style="margin-top: 0px;">Restricted Nodes</h1><p>* Allow-list internet egress via FQDN (e.g. package providers) - enforced at Node Pool VPC level (and cluster NetworkPolicies)</p><p>* gVisor or other sandboxing required for workloads.</p><p>* <span style="color: rgb(150, 115, 166);"><b>L7 (Application level) NetworkPolicy</b></span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(150, 115, 166);"><span style="caret-color: rgb(0, 0, 0); color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">* Default deny NetworkPolicy</span><b><br></b></span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(150, 115, 166);"><span style="caret-color: rgb(0, 0, 0); color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">* Falco for incident detection</span></span></p>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="226" width="250" x="1260" y="79" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="HzRmuRsm71WE9vN8c5Wq-55" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;rounded=0;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;" value="<h1 style="margin-top: 0px;">Private Link</h1><p>* PrivateServiceConnect on GCP, AWS equivalent</p><p>* Single direction L4 network link between two accounts.</p><p>* mTLS between <b>Relay</b> and <b>Router</b></p>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="134" width="318" x="461" y="787" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="HzRmuRsm71WE9vN8c5Wq-60" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=#9673a6;fillColor=#e1d5e7;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;rounded=0;" Cloud DNS logs</b></div><div><b><br></b></div><div><b>* </b>k8s runtime logs (e.g. Falco)</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="116" width="190" x="20" y="1357" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="HzRmuRsm71WE9vN8c5Wq-83" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;rounded=0;" value="* Selectively suppress anomalies from Untrusted Nodes in Hostile Cluster<div>We expect suspicious activity there (e.g. processes spawned, but not cluster k8s attacks)</div><div><br></div><div>* Pay special attention to anomalies &nbsp;in Restricted Nodes in Hostile Cluster - this is egress/privesc path for hostile agents.</div><div><br></div><div>* Canaries are an indicator of compromise or an agent gone rogue and require immediate attention.</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="116" width="429" x="257" y="1357" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="HzRmuRsm71WE9vN8c5Wq-93" edge="1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;rounded=0;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;" value="<h1 style="margin-top: 0px;">Canaries</h1><p>* Canary tokens in key containers (e.g. Artifactory)<br></p><p>* Cluster canaries - secrets, service accounts</p><p>* Project canaries - buckets, secrets etc.</p>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="134" width="280" x="1190" y="791" div.p: * Runs in a semi-trusted account
* Cilium CNI used to enforce NetworkPolicy
* VPC firewall rules may allow restricted Internet egress
* Workload Identity, least privileges etc.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 288px; height: 1px; padding-top: 106px; margin-left: 719px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; max-height: 308px; overflow: hidden; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#333333, #c1c1c1); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.p: * Workloads are considered "actively hostile" and account is "assumed compromised".
* Runs in a dedicated cloud account for hostile workloads - full account-level segmentation from trusted workloads.
* VPC firewall rules on Node Pools enforce internet egress policies outside of the cluster.

* Cluster and account are fully audited to avoid any known cloud account privilege escalation paths from the cluster - so we can still rely on VPC level segmentation rules and account-level security and detection.
* We can't mitigate Cloud 0-days so we focus on limiting blast radius and detection.

div.p: * Assumed compromised
* Zero internet egress - enforced at Node Pool VPC Firewall level (and in-cluster NetworkPolicy)
* Cilium CNI - L4 NetworkPolicy everywhere (default deny NetworkPolicy)
* gVisor or Kata containers

* L7 (Application level) NetworkPolicy

div.div:
* Selectively suppress anomalies from Untrusted Nodes in Hostile Cluster
We expect suspicious activity there (e.g. processes spawned, but not cluster k8s attacks)
* Pay special attention to anomalies in Restricted Nodes in Hostile Cluster - this is egress/privesc path for hostile agents.
* Canaries are an indicator of compromise or an agent gone rogue and require immediate attention.
